stories.title: World Series Game 1: Takeaways from Brewers' win over Rays
stories.summary: The Fall Classic began in Milwaukee on Friday -- and we've got all the action covered.

stories.title: Brewers escape ninth-inning jam, replay drama to take World Series opener
stories.summary: The Brewers survived some late drama, including a seemingly game-ending double play being overturned on review, to beat the Rays 3-2 in Game 1 of the World Series.

stories.title: NFL House in Paris closes ahead of street protests
stories.summary: PARIS -- The NFL closed its "NFL House" in Paris on Saturday as the city braced for street protests with a heavy police presence and storefronts boarded up.

stories.title: 'That's who we are': Rays won't ease up on basepaths despite Game 1 miscues
stories.summary: The Rays said they'll remain aggressive on the bases despite two costly baserunning miscues in Friday's loss to the Brewers in Game 1 of the World Series.

stories.title: Celtics' Tatum denies 'beef' with 76ers' Brown after trade: This isn't Shaq and Kobe
stories.summary: Jayson Tatum spent most of his postgame news conference Friday night addressing speculation about his relationship with former Celtics teammate Jaylen Brown in the wake of Brown's shocking trade to Philadelphia over the summer.
